questions.question: Which plug is commonly called RJ-45 in twisted-pair Ethernet installations?
questions.explanation: 8P8C describes the modular plug's eight positions and contacts. RJ-45 is common Ethernet shorthand.

option_explanations.A: 8P8C describes the modular plug's eight positions and contacts. RJ-45 is common Ethernet shorthand.
option_explanations.D: LC duplex is used for paired fiber strands.

questions.question: Which pair names common fiber Ethernet connector styles?
questions.explanation: LC and SC are optical connector families used on Ethernet links.

option_explanations.A: Both F-type and BNC are coaxial connector styles.
option_explanations.B: 8P8C is a modular copper connector, and BNC is coaxial.
option_explanations.C: LC and SC are optical connector families used on Ethernet links.
option_explanations.D: USB-C and 8P8C are not fiber Ethernet connector styles.

questions.question: A legacy PC and switch use fixed complementary MDI and MDI-X 100BASE-TX ports. Which cable is appropriate?
questions.explanation: Complementary transmit and receive pair assignments line up through a straight-through cable.

option_explanations.A: A crossover would be needed between like fixed port types, not complementary MDI and MDI-X.
option_explanations.B: Complementary transmit and receive pair assignments line up through a straight-through cable.
option_explanations.D: Rollover cabling is associated with console connections.

questions.question: Two fixed MDI-X 100BASE-TX switch ports are directly connected with Auto MDI-X disabled. Which cable is needed?
questions.explanation: The crossover swaps transmit and receive pair positions between like ports.

option_explanations.A: The ports are copper 100BASE-TX rather than optical LC.
option_explanations.B: A console rollover cable does not pair Ethernet transmit and receive correctly.
option_explanations.C: With like pair assignments, straight-through fails to cross the transmit and receive pairs.
option_explanations.D: The crossover swaps transmit and receive pair positions between like ports.

questions.question: What does Auto MDI-X adjust when a supported copper Ethernet link is brought up?

options.A: The VLAN identifier in the Ethernet header
options.B: The port's transmit and receive pair assignment
options.C: The speed of light in the cable
options.D: The strand type of an optic

questions.explanation: Auto MDI-X resolves wiring orientation so either appropriate straight-through or crossover cabling can work.

option_explanations.A: VLAN tagging is a frame-level operation.
option_explanations.B: Auto MDI-X resolves wiring orientation so either appropriate straight-through or crossover cabling can work.
option_explanations.C: Auto MDI-X swaps the pair roles and does not change electrical propagation speed.
option_explanations.D: Auto MDI-X concerns copper pairs, not fiber type.

questions.question: Which UTP category is the conventional choice for a full 100 m 10GBASE-T channel from the options shown?
questions.explanation: Cat 6A is specified for 10GBASE-T over the full channel length under the standard installation limits.

option_explanations.A: Cat 3 does not meet the 10GBASE-T channel requirements.
option_explanations.B: Cat 5 is not rated for full-length 10GBASE-T.
option_explanations.C: Cat 6A is specified for 10GBASE-T over the full channel length under the standard installation limits.
option_explanations.D: Cat 5e is not the conventional choice for the full 100 m 10GBASE-T channel.

questions.question: A link is specified for 10GBASE-SR at both ends. Which installed medium suits those optics?

options.C: Single-mode fiber chosen solely because it has LC connectors

questions.explanation: SR optics are designed for multimode fiber. Connector shape alone does not determine optical compatibility.

option_explanations.A: Cat 6A supports twisted-pair transceivers such as 10GBASE-T, not 10GBASE-SR optics.
option_explanations.B: A console cable carries no optical Ethernet signal.
option_explanations.C: An LC connector alone does not make single-mode fiber suitable for SR optics.
option_explanations.D: SR optics are designed for multimode fiber. Connector shape alone does not determine optical compatibility.

questions.question: Two buildings are 2 km apart. Which option meets that distance when standard optics and compliant media are used?
questions.explanation: Single-mode 10GBASE-LR supports kilometer-scale links. The other listed choices have shorter rated reach.

option_explanations.A: A standard Cat 6A 10GBASE-T channel is up to 100 m, far below 2 km.
option_explanations.B: OM3 multimode with 10GBASE-SR supports hundreds of meters rather than 2 km.
option_explanations.C: Single-mode 10GBASE-LR supports kilometer-scale links. The other listed choices have shorter rated reach.
option_explanations.D: 1000BASE-T over Cat 5e is a copper link with a 100 m channel limit.

questions.question: A new two-strand LC link has the correct fiber and compatible optics. Both transmitters work, but light from each transmitter reaches the peer transmitter position. Which change addresses the link fault?

options.A: Replace both duplex LC plugs with the same orientation
options.B: Swap the strands at both ends
options.C: Force both interfaces to half duplex
options.D: Correct the strand polarity at one end

questions.explanation: Each transmitter must reach the peer receiver. Swapping both ends would recreate the original pairing.

option_explanations.A: Replacing connectors with the same orientation leaves transmit-to-transmit polarity intact.
option_explanations.B: Swapping both ends preserves the same end-to-end polarity.
option_explanations.C: Duplex settings cannot make light arrive at a receiver connected to the other strand.
option_explanations.D: Each transmitter must reach the peer receiver. Swapping both ends would recreate the original pairing.

questions.question: A short UTP link crosses an environment with severe electromagnetic interference. Which change addresses that issue without relying on shielding or rerouting?

options.A: Swap between two straight-through UTP patch cords
options.B: Use a supported optical Ethernet link
options.C: Switch from matching full duplex to half duplex

questions.explanation: Optical fiber transports light rather than electrical signals and is immune to electromagnetic interference in the data path.

option_explanations.A: Another unshielded patch cord does not remove the interference exposure.
option_explanations.B: Optical fiber transports light rather than electrical signals and is immune to electromagnetic interference in the data path.
option_explanations.C: Duplex mode changes transmission behavior but does not remove induced noise.
option_explanations.D: DHCP lease time does not affect electrical interference.
